title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions between two shots, shown going from the sample clip to a graphics frame. Pixel transitions rework the picture point by point; 3D mesh transitions cut it into tiles and move them in space.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "cube_spin", "seconds": 0.5}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "scan_wipe", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.4}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl).

items.name: rgb glitch
items.description: Blocks and rows jump sideways with red and blue pulled apart while the picture swaps underneath.

items.name: datamosh
items.description: Blocks freeze, smear along their own motion and are replaced out of order, like a corrupted stream.

items.name: pixel dissolve
items.description: The picture drops to coarse blocks, swaps, and sharpens again.

items.name: scan wipe
items.description: A bright scanning beam travels down the frame and draws the next shot behind it.

items.name: hex reveal
items.description: Hexagonal cells close and reopen on the next shot, rippling out from the centre.

items.name: warp wipe
items.description: A diagonal wipe whose edge stretches both pictures, with a glowing seam.

items.name: luma melt
items.description: Columns drip down at different speeds while the bright areas burn through first.

items.name: iris glow
items.description: An iris opens from the centre behind a glowing, ticked ring that bends the picture at its edge.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: The camera punches through the shot in a zoom blur and lands on the next one.

items.name: noise dissolve
items.description: Blocky digital noise eats the shot away behind a hot cyan edge.

items.name: hologram in
items.description: The next shot flickers in as a cyan projection, then gains its real color.

items.name: crt collapse
items.description: The shot switches off like a tube monitor, down to a line and a dot, and the next one switches on.

items.name: radar sweep
items.description: A radar arm sweeps once around the centre, leaving the next shot under a fading trail.

items.name: cube spin
items.description: Both shots are faces of a box that turns a quarter of the way round.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: The shot folds up like a concertina toward the left edge, uncovering the next one.

items.name: shatter
items.description: The shot breaks into tiles that tumble toward the camera, the centre first.

items.name: wave sheet
items.description: A ring of ripples runs out across the picture; behind it is already the next shot.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The shot splits down the middle into two doors that swing open onto the next shot.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: Horizontal slices tilt and slide off to alternate sides at different speeds.

items.name: tile flip
items.description: A grid of cards turns over in a diagonal wave, with the next shot on the back of each.
